input.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
input.reasoning_summary:
After reviewing my critique, my initial verdict of INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE remains correct.

Weakness 1 questioned my fiscal quarter timing interpretation. The evidence confirms my understanding was correct: E5 shows "Fiscal Year 2027 2026 First Quarter" data, confirming that FY2027 Q1 ended September 30, 2026. This means Q2 FY2027 would end December 31, 2026, exactly as I interpreted. This challenge is refuted.

Weakness 2 suggested checking for forward-looking statements about Q2 FY2027. I found no relevant evidence in any of the supplied passages containing preliminary results or guidance for the quarter ended December 31, 2026.

Weakness 3 questioned whether the evidence cutoff could include Q2 FY2027 results. The evidence refutes this concern: E5 (filed 2026-10-28 for period ending 2026-09-30) is the most recent filing available, covering only through Q1 FY2027. Since the evidence cutoff is November 1, 2026, and the quarter in question doesn't even end until December 31, 2026, there is no possibility of having the required financial data.

The claim requires revenue data for the quarter ended December 31, 2026 and the comparable prior year quarter (ended December 31, 2025). Neither period's data is available in the evidence provided. Therefore, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is the appropriate verdict.
input.change_reason: No change. All three weaknesses were either refuted by the evidence or found to have no relevant evidence. The initial verdict of INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE remains correct because the necessary financial data for the quarter ended December 31, 2026 is not available in any of the supplied evidence.
